title: Risk Score
description: Output of the risk-scoring-engine. Contains usage and maintenance scores for a vehicle, along with contributing factors for explainability and regulatory transparency.

score_id.description: Unique identifier for this score computation.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle being scored.

usage_score.description: Driving behaviour / usage risk score (0 = highest risk, 100 = lowest risk).

maintenance_score.description: Maintenance adherence score (0 = poorest adherence, 100 = perfect adherence).

composite_score.description: Weighted composite of usage and maintenance scores (optional — computed by pricing-policy if not provided).

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this score was computed.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the ML model that produced this score (e.g. 'v2.3.1').

factor_name.description: Human-readable name of the contributing factor (e.g. 'hard_braking_frequency', 'oil_change_adherence').

impact.description: Normalised SHAP-style importance weight (0–1). All impacts across factors should sum to ≈ 1.

direction.description: Whether this factor is improving or worsening the score.

description.description: Plain-language explanation suitable for customer-facing display (optional).

contributing_factors.description: Ordered list of factors that contributed to the score, for explainability.
